title: REAPER MCP server
summary: Guarded MCP control of the REAPER DAW through a local Lua bridge: projects, tracks, MIDI, FX and patch state, rendering. The action surface used by the Bouch audio workbenches. Tools are exposed in selectable profiles; enumerate the live server rather than trusting a count. Local stdio server, not a remote service.

source.note: Bouch fork of the third-party upstream https://github.com/danishaft/reaper-mcp (published on PyPI as danishaft-reaper-mcp), forked from upstream tag v0.1.0. The ref is the adapter state used by the Audio V2 workbench, carrying the Bouch extensions (CLAP patch state, guarded project lifecycle, DecentSampler loading, MIDI sysex, track channel count); its tag message records the provenance. V1 (reaper-agent-lab) evidence was produced against upstream v0.1.0.

native.note: No server.json exists and the server is not listed in the MCP Registry.
